benchmark_metadata.description: Rigorous Evaluation Dataset for EVIDRA over real PDF policy documents: Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023, WHO Constitution, and Universal Declaration of Human Rights.

questions.query: Under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, what is the maximum penalty for failure to take reasonable security safeguards to prevent a personal data breach?
questions.notes: Section 8(5) breach listed in Schedule penalty table.

questions.query: What is the official definition of health according to the Constitution of the World Health Organization?
required_facts: not merely the absence of disease
questions.notes: Preamble principle 1 of the WHO Constitution.

questions.query: According to Article 3 of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, what three basic rights are guaranteed to everyone?
questions.notes: Direct factual lookup in Article 3 UDHR.

questions.query: Under the DPDP Act 2023, what is the maximum penalty for a Data Principal who fails to comply with duties under Section 15?
questions.notes: Schedule penalty item (5) for breach in observing duties.
